columns.name: WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: The system generated primary key.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing to FAI_WORKFLOWS table.

columns.name: EXECUTION_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Collection of workflow execution steps grouped within one workflow execution.

columns.name: TRACE
columns.description: Execution traceId captured at runtime.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: This field will capture type of execution.

columns.name: STEP
columns.description: This field will store Workflow step of this execution.

columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to HR_GEN_AI_AGENTS table.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The user identification who executes the Workflow.

columns.name: EXECUTION_DETAILS
columns.description: This field will store details of step execution.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: EXECUTION_TIME
columns.description: Time taken to execute the step

columns.name: LLM_REQ_INPUT_TOKEN_CNT
columns.description: Token count for  LLM input

columns.name: LLM_OUTPUT_TOKEN_CNT
columns.description: Token count for LLM output

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source of invocation. Can be Admin/Eval/End_User etc.,

columns.name: TRIGGER_TYPE
columns.description: Conversation was triggered by Email/Webhook etc.,
